name: Flysnapper 0.3.0 real-guitar evaluation scope
purpose: Prepare an honestly measured build for the user's own guitar; not a claim of flawless transcription or universal musical readiness
polyphonic_output: Fixed semitone Note On/Off, with mono continuous bend retained separately

out_of_scope.reason: The user explicitly removed polyphonic bending. These historical recordings remain intact and are listed as outside this evaluation, never counted as passes.

accuracy_source: Retain the November 4 policy's note, release, mono expression and output safety criteria; do not retain its absolute latency checkpoint requirements

scoring.static_poly_interval_identity: MIDI note number, since no physical string identity or continuous per-voice curve is required

acceptance_roles.mandatory: The unchanged frozen30 packaging gate plus all native integration groups, including dedicated actual-processor dynamics/calibration controls, must pass before producing the new evaluation installer.
acceptance_roles.broad_existing_corpora: Retain every scoped case's original accuracy/release pass or failure and all raw events as diagnostic regression evidence. Arbitrary overlapping recorded percussion at comparable level is not promised error-free. These failures must be disclosed rather than changed into passes or used to claim universal musical readiness.
acceptance_roles.calibration: Every benchmark must state off/default/manual/learned settings and the independent calibration input. Calibration machinery success alone is not proof of real-guitar noise rejection.

real_recording_limits: Existing CC0 isolated samples and recorded interference mixtures do not establish complete continuous human slide/hammer/pull/bend coverage. The delivered build is intended for real-guitar evaluation under the revised request, not a substitute for that observation.
